episodes.title: Oh Sung Moo Has Disappeared!
episodes.summary: Oh Sung Moo writes the most popular webtoon series known as "W," disappears on the day before he is supposed to finish the final episode of the webtoon.

episodes.title: Find Her, the Key to My Life
episodes.summary: Sung Moo, who has disappeared for a while, is back. Yun Joo tries to figure out what has happened to her last night, but Sung Moo doesn't tell her anything.

episodes.title: I'm Someone Who Will Do That
episodes.summary: Soo Bong starts to believe what Yun Joo says about getting dragged into the world of W. Yun Joo gets dragged into the graphic novel once again, and Kang Chul takes her to his place. He starts to ask questions about her.

episodes.title: What Is This World Where You Live in?
episodes.summary: Kang Chul tells Hyun Suk that Yun Joo is the only one who can reveal the secrets of his life. Meanwhile,Yun Joo gets arrested because of So Hee. Kang Chul visits Yun Joo in prison.

episodes.title: I've Come Here. To Your World.
episodes.summary: Yun Joo's professor urgently calls Yun Joo and asks her to get a spoiler about a popular graphic novel series, W, from her father. He promises that he will give her the opportunity to perform a surgery if she does

episodes.title: Save Kang Chul! Save Him!
episodes.summary: Yun Joo hurriedly heads to Sung Moo's workroom, but Sung Moo has already been shot by Kang Chul. Kang Chul leaves his last letter to Yun Joo, and heads to the Han River Bridge to make a proper ending for himself.

episodes.title: I Was Scared. That I Wouldn't Be Able to See You Again
episodes.summary: Kang Chul wakes up from sleep as if nothing has happened. Yun Joo gets arrested in Kang Chul's world. Yeon Joo tells Kang Chul that they should create a new sequel on their own. Kang Chul decides to give up on catching the real culprit.

episodes.title: Oh Yeon Joo, Forget Me Now
episodes.summary: Yun Joo bleeds in Kang Chul's world, and Chul is worried that she could die. The real culprit is out in the real world and finds Yun Joo. To fix everything, Kang Chul asks Yun Joo to draw something.

episodes.title: The Person Is the Sole Man Kang Chul Will Accept
episodes.summary: Yun Joo gets dragged into the story again, but Kang Chul doesn't recognize her anymore. In order to make a logical happy ending, Sung Moo draws the real culprit's face.

episodes.title: Are You Suspecting Me Now?
episodes.summary: Yun Joo is stuck in the world of W, and Kang Chul is bothered by the way Yun Joo looks at him. Chul Ho gets in trouble with the appearance of the real culprit.

episodes.title: CEO Kang Has Been Looking for You, Oh Yeon Joo
episodes.summary: Yun Joo comes back to the real world and discovers that Sung Moo has lost his face. She finds out that the story was being drawn by the real culprit. Yun Joo takes Sung Moo's tablet and starts drawing again to save Kang Chul.

episodes.title: From Now On, I Summon Myself
episodes.summary: As soon as Kang Chul realizes once again that he is the character in a graphic novel, a gate to the real world appears. Kang Chul talks with the real culprit in Sung Moo's workshop. The real culprit says that Chul will soon cease to exist

episodes.title: The Finale of W Begins Now
episodes.summary: A funeral service for Kang Chul is held in the world of W. Kang Chul and Yun Joo dream of having a happy and ordinary life of a couple in the real world. However, another variable appears and the real culprit escapes and kidnaps Yun Joo.

episodes.title: She Is Dead a While Ago
episodes.summary: Sung Moo gets his face back. He remembers the real culprit's memories and looks for Yun Joo, but he soon finds out that Yun Joo is dead. Meanwhile, Kang Chul falls into Han Chul Ho's trap while trying to look for the tablet.

episodes.title: We Should Decide Now to Make Ending
episodes.summary: Yun Joo is back in the world of W, and she meets Kang Chul at the courthouse. Meanwhile, Han Chul Ho kidnaps Doh Yoon in order to get a hold of Kang Chul. Yun Joo and Kang Chul try to decide on the ending of the story.

episodes.title: I Love You
episodes.summary: Yun Joo and Kang Chul escape from their safe house after getting surrounded by the police. Kang Chul goes to Han Chul Ho in order to rescue Doh Yoon. Han Chul Ho now knows about the world of W. Will Chul be able to have a happy ending?
